pose a threat.definition_en: to create or present a possible danger or risk
pose a threat.example_en: The new security flaw could pose a threat to millions of users.
pose a threat.example_zh: 這個新的安全漏洞可能對數百萬名使用者構成威脅。

take a measured tone.definition_en: to speak or respond in a calm, careful, and controlled way
take a measured tone.example_en: The minister took a measured tone when discussing the disagreement.
take a measured tone.example_zh: 部長在談到這項分歧時採取了審慎克制的語氣。
